diagnostic_scope: Simulated/reference optical models, not user-confirmed material data or manufacturing acceptance.
legacy_summary_note: Original summaries may report available=false due tuple handling; this draft relies on corrected summaries and verification-final. Original private summaries are preserved, not overwritten.
